description: Paid endpoint ($0.005): Pre-payment payee check for any x402 endpoint: reads its unpaid 402 challenge (nothing paid or signed), compares payTo with the address you expect (address=0x...) and with the seller's /.well-known/x402, checks the asset is USDC on a known network, mainnet vs testnet, price vs listing and HTTPS. Returns pass/warn/fail with each check. Blocked/invalid url 400, no charge. Returns the x402 payment requirements and URL.

url.description: x402 endpoint you plan to pay

name: check_x402_payee
title: x402 pre-payment payee check (paid, x402) — $0.005

x402.behavior: Tool returns x402 payment requirements + URL; caller pays over HTTP with own wallet. Charged only on HTTP 200.
